name: Dragon of Phobos
_notes: Transcribed from sheet EU3022 (Lv I-IX), trait cards (Phobian Hierarchy, Fat with Fear, A Truth for a Truth, A Lie for a Truth), AI ER3023-ER3042, 18 BP cards, Storybook p.174-175 setup.
Titan facing is not tracked: a Titan is treated as facing the board centre, so "behind" = the side away from the centre.
Ranges of light: a space is lit if within X spaces of a Titan with Light X, or within the Light value of a Lightwall / Arcology tile (all directions).
BP codes ES3043-ES3060; Full Miss effects (card backs) matched to the fronts by sheet position.

traits.Vanish X: Move the Dragon of Phobos X spaces towards the closest Board Edge, without turning, ignoring the Board Edges directly across from the Target or attacking Titan. If this would move the Dragon of Phobos beyond a Board Edge or outside of all ranges of light, it disappears (remove the Dragon of Phobos from the Battle Board). When the Dragon of Phobos is outside the Battle Board, it cannot be affected in any way.
traits.Phobian Hierarchy: If the Dragon of Phobos is outside of the Battle Board when drawing AI or performing a Signature, instead of normal Targeting, use Target: Hierarchy. Instead of performing any movement instructions (like ⚡ Move & Attack): if the space directly behind the Target is empty, appear behind the Target, if able; if that space is occupied, appear to the side, then front (even if occupied, standard Crash rules apply). Finally, without moving, continue resolving the AI or Signature.
traits.Pale Grin of Doom: When you are attacked from behind, ignore the Evasion Roll; the Attack automatically hits with all the dice.
traits.A Truth for a Truth: Each time the Dragon of Phobos disappears or gains a Wound (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds), place a token on this Trait. After resolving the current action, if there are 4 or more tokens on this Trait, discard all tokens, then draw and resolve the top AI card.
traits.Fat with Fear: For each dead Titan, reduce Vanish by 1.
traits.Fear is Constant: Start of Battle: Chosen Titan gains the Fear Condition card, another Titan gains the Terror Condition card, a third one flips 1 Oxygen token.
traits.Blacker Than The Night: When the Dragon of Phobos performs Vanish X, it doesn't ignore the Board Edges directly across from the Target or attacking Titan.
traits.Pale Grin of Death: When you are attacked from behind, ignore the Evasion Roll. You are immediately devoured (dead).
traits.A Lie for a Truth: This replaces the A Truth for a Truth Trait. Each time the Dragon of Phobos gains a Wound (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds), place a token on this Trait. After resolving the current action, if there are 3 or more tokens on this Trait, discard all tokens. The Dragon of Phobos disappears. Then, draw and resolve the top AI card.
traits.Light Is Dimming: If you don't have any Light X keyword, you are always considered to be attacked from behind.
traits.Psychosomatic Poisoning: Start of Battle: Place an Ambrosia token on the Condition deck. When you gain a Condition card, and each time you start your turn with a Condition card, gain 1 Ambrosia token.
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Relentless Anxiety: When the Dragon of Phobos vanishes, immediately draw an AI card.
traits.Deeper Depths: Each Titan starts the Battle with 1 Oxygen token less.
traits.Original Trench: Normal (not Terrain) Battle Board spaces are considered Terrain tiles with the Chasm keyword. All other Terrain is considered Elevated.
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Dragon of the Lightless Void: You can only use X amount of Opening or Closing tokens from the Kratos Pool. You can only use X amount of Break, Fire, Black, and Hope tokens from the Kratos Pool combined. X is equal to your Light X keyword.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
